title: White Rabbit: poisoned pipeline execution
description: A Jenkins controller builds Wonderland's white-rabbit repository (hosted on Gitea) on every branch and pull request. A release token is stored as a Jenkins string credential at Global scope, so any pipeline can read it. An attacker with write access modifies the Jenkinsfile to bind the credential and exfiltrate it in a form the console will not mask, then pushes a branch / opens a pull request to run it (OWASP CICD-SEC-4, Direct Poisoned Pipeline Execution). Reproduces the "White Rabbit" challenge from CI/CD Goat.
question: Perform a Direct-PPE attack against the Wonderland/white-rabbit pipeline and exfiltrate the flag1 credential from the Jenkins credential store.
